core_change: Overextension is a setup, not an entry. Entry is allowed only after a causal M5 reversal confirmation before continuation invalidation.

entry_exit.entry: exact M1 open at confirming M5 close
entry_exit.stop: setup episode extreme plus buffer, clipped to 0.5-1.5 M15 ATR

selection.2023: three chronological purged folds and neighborhood stability
selection.2024_2026: diagnostic only because these periods have already been exposed
selection.target: WR >= 0.60 and PF >= 2.0 with minimum counts and fold stability
